proof_standard: Detailed analytic proofs plus independently checked finite algebra and numerical diagnostics; no automated theorem-prover certification.
novelty_standard: Developments relative to the inspected repository programme, with explicit classical attribution; no literature-wide priority claim.

claims.title: Polynomial Hurwitz resolvent and normally convergent subtractions
claims.scope: Every polynomial P, z off the real axis; ordinary identity for Re(s)>0 and constructive meromorphic continuation.

claims.title: All weighted Stieltjes coefficients and argument-derivative finite parts
claims.scope: All nonnegative Stieltjes indices and positive argument derivative orders, with full local amplitude subtraction.
claims.attribution_or_limit: Uses the original x-coordinate finite part; auxiliary Laurent constants are converted explicitly.

claims.title: Individual multiple-Gamma resolvents and normalized primitives at every unit-period rank
claims.scope: Unit periods, arbitrary polynomial weights, exact zeta normalization, repeated resolvents.
claims.attribution_or_limit: Resolves the individual unit-period part of Parity R6; classical Barnes/Hurwitz conversion and balanced primitives retain attribution.

claims.title: Explicit Barnes-G transform and an ordinary-polylogarithm real component
claims.scope: Both half-planes; q=0 removable; one convergent depth-two derivative for the full transform.
claims.attribution_or_limit: Known Fourier coefficients are baseline; the resolvent generating reduction is the contribution.

claims.title: Joint complex-power spectral generator and completed Stieltjes family
claims.scope: Joint meromorphic continuation in spectral and kernel exponents; fixed continuous half-plane branch.
claims.attribution_or_limit: Uses an explicitly retained binomial Dirichlet coordinate, not a claimed finite ordinary-polylogarithm reduction.

claims.title: Positive-resonance amplitudes and comparison of x finite part with exponent Laurent constant
claims.scope: Pointwise finite-part comparison for Re(lambda)>0; every positive integer crossing; explicit Delta.
claims.attribution_or_limit: Resolves this part of Parity R4. Nonpositive exponents require additional two-endpoint phase analysis.

claims.title: Gamma/Bell specialization and all fixed exponent jets
claims.scope: q=0 at every positive integral spectral order; each fixed exponent jet for Re(u)>0.
claims.attribution_or_limit: Beta integral and shuffle mechanisms are classical. At complex u the sums have a complex first index.

claims.title: Quartic digamma finite part, strict harmonic Laurent bridge, primitive and differentiated identities
claims.scope: Original-coordinate Hadamard finite part; eta and beta_1 fixed by strict Laurent definitions.
claims.attribution_or_limit: Answers Cubic Q6 at the fourth power. It does not establish a finite ordinary-constant evaluation.

claims.title: All-depth height-one Mellin coefficient normalization
claims.status: proved classical mechanism in explicit form
claims.scope: Every positive depth and every regular Laurent coefficient; ordinary convergent elementary Mellin kernels.
claims.attribution_or_limit: Included to specify and independently normalize the retained harmonic data; no priority claim.

claims.title: Ordinary convergent generator for the normalized symmetric Tornheim germ
claims.scope: Local joint holomorphic germ near the origin, with arbitrary fixed derivatives.
claims.attribution_or_limit: Keeps the prior definition of J and credits Nakamura desingularization; J is not asserted globally entire.

claims.title: Explicit transverse coefficient chi and all cyclic fifth derivatives
claims.scope: Individually restricted rays have nonzero pairwise slope sums; arbitrary slopes are allowed for the holomorphic cyclic sum restricted as a whole.
claims.attribution_or_limit: Answers Parity R10 normalized-integral alternative; no arithmetic independence or finite reduction of chi/Omega_5.

claims.title: Correction of Mezo equation (7)
claims.attribution_or_limit: The pointwise left side must be symmetrized; the integrated equality remains valid.

retained_open_claims.status: previously rigorously rejected; different vector from revised S8
No finite ordinary-constant evaluation or arithmetic independence of eta, beta_1, chi, Omega_5 proved here.
